Offload подключается к IDE как MCP-серве: Offload connects to IDEs as an MCP server: the IDE runs “Offload.exe --mcp” itself and can delegate reading files, reviewing changes, commit messages and simple edits to the local model. The IDE settings file is backed up before it is changed.
Файлы в ~/.claude объясняют Claude, каки: Files in ~/.claude tell Claude which tasks are worth delegating to the local model.
Правило ~/.claude/rules/offload.md загру: The ~/.claude/rules/offload.md rule is loaded in every session — Claude delegates more actively.
Субагент ~/.claude/agents/offload-runner: The ~/.claude/agents/offload-runner.md subagent runs batches of mechanical tasks through the local model.
Инструменты записи создают и правят файл: Write tools create and edit project files; every edit is recorded and can be undone (local_job).
После изменений перезапустите Claude Cod: Restart Claude Code after making changes.

OpenCode — агент для программирования. O: OpenCode is a coding agent. Offload runs it with the local model so the model can do multi-step tasks: read the project, edit several files and check the result. A standalone executable is installed into the Offload folder; Node.js is not needed.
Если выключено, правки выполняются тольк: When off, edits are made only by the local model rewriting files directly, without the agent.
Провайдер «offload» появится в вашем обы: The “offload” provider will appear in your regular OpenCode (the config is backed up first). This is not required for working through Offload — it has its own managed configuration.

Дополнительные правила для локальной мод: Extra rules for the local model
Этот текст добавляется к системному пром: This text is added to the local model's system prompt in all Offload tasks: project conventions, code style, comment language. Keep it short — a long prompt takes up the model's context.
Команды, которыми локальная модель может: Commands the local model can use to check its edit (the verify_command parameter: build, tests, linter). One pattern per line; “*” at the end means “any arguments”. Commands with shell operators (&&, |, ;, >) are always rejected.
КБ — файлы больше не читаются: KB — larger files are not read
